label: Guilin: the centre named Guilin, Lingui with it
why: The zone shown as Guilin (lbe, by a hand name) holds Lingui, Yongfu, Luzhai and Liucheng but none of Guilin's centre; the centre (Xiufeng, Diecai, Qixing, Xiangshan, Yanshan) is in lgx, shown as Lingchuan. 29% of lbe's commutes cross its line, split evenly between Guilin's centre (90,000 a day) and Liuzhou (84,000). lbe is retired: Lingui, the new Guilin city district, and Yongfu (Guilin prefecture) join lgx, named Guilin; Luzhai and Liucheng (Liuzhou prefecture) join Liuzhou's metro (liu). Liuzhou's pop_vs_fua is relaxed for every Chinese metro (T-897).
note: Now: Lingui (lbe) is the zone the game shows as Guilin, and Lingchuan (lgx) holds Guilin's centre.
